objective: Evaluate wheat-fitted adaptations of the maize_phen_dl causal LSTM and temporal-convolution positive-development models against frozen T-P-V
split: Existing frozen calibration, validation and testing stations; no test station contributes labels, normalization or stopping decisions
scope: Retrospective spatial comparison; existing test results informed the research question. Calendar years are not held out.
objective_function: Stage-equal discrete CRPS on observed dates and available weather only
selection: Validation-only stopping and family choice; three fixed seeds retained, no test-based hyperparameter changes
weather: Known-sowing realized-weather hindcast; contiguous prefix beginning on sowing day; maximum 366 days; no future-window or observed-stage inputs
process_prior: Frozen wheat T-P-V daily increments and four native thresholds; neural positive multiplier learned from wheat only
uncertainty: Common marginal log-progress scale preserves ordered stage CDFs; no claim of calibrated weather or structural uncertainty
evaluation: Common observed wheat events; stage-wise MAE/RMSE/bias, failed-crossing coverage, station-cluster paired intervals and all-event failure-penalized error
replacement_rule: A station-phenology candidate must improve validation and test stage-equal error with paired station-bootstrap support and no worse soft-dough error or coverage. Full disease-engine replacement additionally requires evaluated final-leaf and flowering support and climate applicability; native-stage improvement alone cannot authorize it.
climate_results: Existing climate simulations and manuscript impact claims remain linked to their original phenology implementation until any replacement is independently supported and the simulations are rerun
